case.pattern_description: Repeated disputed card-present activity in a familiar region did not match the known out-of-region pattern; the agent treated it as an undocumented recurring abuse pattern.

evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3530164 is in_person for $49.00; benchmark risk score is 0.40.
The card has 981 earlier transactions in the local investigation slice; the flagged amount is 0.38× its historical average.
5 prior confirmed-fraud cases are recorded against this card.
The trigger is a customer report stating the flagged purchase was not authorized.

case.summary: Investigation of 3530164 assessed undocumented with a pre-evidence fraud probability of 0.89. The assumed evidence response supports unauthorized activity; 2 transaction(s) are in the identified episode with $165.93 exposure.

initial.reason: 3a: fraud probability is sufficient to open an internal case.
R4/R1: keep the card active while authorization is established.

final.reason: R2: customer/analyst evidence supports unauthorized activity.
R2/3a: maintain the internal investigation record.
